name: Corn noodle with tuna offal
nameVi: Bún bắp lòng cá ngừ đại dương
summary: Corn noodle in a broth of tuna stomach, roe, tomato, and pineapple. Du lịch Phú Yên says Hiệp hội Văn hóa Ẩm thực Việt Nam certified this bowl among 121 dishes in phase I-2022, and that it was the only Phú Yên dish on that list. A street and a price are Check on arrival.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s article on the certified bowl. The noodle is the An Dân corn noodle. Giò heo is the other bowl on the 10 June 2021 article.
culture: Du lịch Phú Yên says Hiệp hội Văn hóa Ẩm thực Việt Nam certified 121 dishes in phase I-2022, and that bún bắp lòng cá ngừ đại dương was the only Phú Yên dish on that list.
texture: Yellow strands, chewier than rice noodle, with a smell of their own. The article says 6–7 steps over nearly 10 days. The 10 June 2021 An Dân article says 6–7 days for a batch. Both stay. The stomach is crisp. The roe crackles and is fatty.
taste: The article wants a light sweet broth, kept free of the fishy smell of sea fish, with a hot finish. Tomato and pineapple go in the ladle, with scallion, rau răm, and pepper.
howToEat: Ladle broth with tuna stomach, roe, tomato, and pineapple over the corn noodle. Add scallion, rau răm, and pepper. Eat it with herbs, bean sprouts, and salty fish sauce.

The article also names mắt cá ngừ, lẩu cá ngừ, cháo cá ngừ, bánh canh cá ngừ, cá ngừ kho thơm, and cá ngừ chiên as other tuna plates. Those methods are not printed. Check on arrival. A price for this bowl is Check on arrival.
where: A street was not printed. Check on arrival. The noodle is from Tuy An on the 10 June 2021 article.
seoTitle: Bun bap with tuna offal — the certified Phu Yen bowl
